story.text: Croatia and Brazil drew 1-1 in the Quarter-finals of the FIFA World Cup 2022. Croatia won 4-2 on penalties after extra time. Croatia had more of the ball (50 percent to 50 percent), and Brazil created the better chances by expected goals, or xG, a measure of chance quality (1.86 to 0.78). The goals came from Neymar at 105:35 and Bruno Petković at 116:02.
